$comment: Cover-sheet spec only. The component inventory — ids, sections, groups, captions and per-variant tags — lives next to the @Previews as @CatalogGroup / @CatalogComponent / @CatalogVariant annotations under catalog/src/main/kotlin/ee/schimke/m3catalog/sections/, and the design-artifacts export builds the catalog from those. This file carries just the fields that are not per-component code metadata: the system slug, title, the libraries covered, the primary modes, the documented breakpoints, the front-door hero, and the seed-kit reference. To override or add a component from here, add a `groups` array — a spec component is layered on top of its matching annotation as a field-level override.
